title: EarnUi layer stack: back, restore and fade are three fields of one 'layer open' mode, kept in step by hand with the session's info column
trigger: Open an earn page from an info panel, navigate inside the layer, switch account and back
effect: Back stack, covered info panel and fade can disagree (Farewell closes by hand through close_earn_boxes + drop_earn_layer); no single owner value
fix: enum EarnLayer { Closed, Open{back,restore}, Fading{..} } owning back/restore/fade; fold learn+diamonds into the Learn box value

title: EarnUi::learn bool with diamonds counter: box open flag plus its easter-egg counter that must reset when the box closes
trigger: Open Learn more, tap the diamond several times, close, reopen
effect: diamonds count survives the box unless every closer zeroes it
fix: learn: Option<LearnBox{diamonds}> so closing drops the counter

title: Edit Image on a photo not yet downloaded sends ensure_media_files once and tells the user to choose again; nothing remembers the wish
trigger: Edit a message with a photo that is not on disk, choose Edit Image
effect: A note says 'downloading, choose again'; the user must repeat the action, and a failed download is never reported
fix: an EditImage stage on the edit (Downloading{file_id} -> Ready/Failed) that opens the editor on arrival

title: EmojiBarUi (expanded + two scroll handles) is shared by the ':' suggestions and the word bar; unhover resets it only when suggest.active is none
trigger: Hover a lit word bar, expand it, type ':' query, or close the word bar while suggestions are open
effect: Bar opens expanded or scrolled for the next list unless every closer remembers the 'unless suggestions are using it' rule (unhover, settle_word_bar, pick_word_emoji each repeat it)
fix: one bar owner enum { Closed, Suggest{expanded}, Word{expanded} } so a new list replaces the whole value

title: with_custom_emoji asks for installed emoji sets from the item builder (hover, typing) every time sets are missing
trigger: Premium user with no installed emoji sets, hover lit words or type ':' repeatedly
effect: ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets is called on each rebuild; the driver dedups with can_ask so it is wasted work not a loop, but a Failed installed list is retried only if can_ask allows
fix: request from the owner of the list on open of the composer, not from a pure item builder

title: emoji_set_return_tab (pickers) mirrors the tab the session panel shows (stickers.emoji.tab); two fields for one tab, written by hand together
trigger: Open the box, switch to Trending, search, clear the search
effect: TabBar highlights return_tab while the list is chosen by panel.tab; open/select/clear each keep them in step; a refresh_emoji_pack_catalog that moves panel.tab leaves return_tab stale
fix: one value: EmojiPanel::tab + search overlay Option<Search{query}>, tab bar reads it

title: Search debounce is a counter (emoji_set_keystroke) beside a detached timer Task
trigger: Type in the emoji packs search, close the box, reopen
effect: Each closer and opener must remember to bump the counter (open, close, select tab, typed); a missed bump lets an old timer search into a new box. Task is .detach()ed instead of held in a stage
fix: hold the debounce Task in a SearchStage on the box (Idle|Waiting{task}) so closing drops it

title: Sheet::Failed is final: a sheet that failed to decode (transient read error) is never asked for again until the set is reinstalled
trigger: Sheet file unreadable once (disk busy, partial write), then fine
effect: That sheet's emoji stay on the system glyph for the whole session
fix: Failed{at} retried after a backoff or when the set is reinstalled; Loading holds its Task instead of a detached spawn

title: Sheet::Loading names a decode but the spawned task is .detach()ed; staleness checked by Rc::ptr_eq on the atlas instead of held in the stage
trigger: Switch emoji set while a sheet decodes
effect: Works through the ptr_eq guard; the stage does not own its work
fix: Sheet::Loading{task: Task<()>} dropped with the atlas

title: switch_emoji_set and download_emoji_set return silently when app_root() is None: no stage, no Failed, no note
trigger: No writable data folder, click a set row
effect: Row click does nothing and says nothing (install-from-file does report it)
fix: set SetStage::Failed{id, why} on that path

title: Startup enum NotStarted/Reading/Done is set to Done before the read is spawned, then overwritten with Reading; early return leaves Done
trigger: First frame with no data folder
effect: Stage is assigned by hand outside its own transitions (Done then Reading); a once-flag in disguise
fix: set Reading only when the task exists; Done from the task

title: EmojiStyleUi::open bool beside DialogKind::EmojiSetStyle, and SetStage::Switching holds only a Task with no set id; completion matches by captured id and loaded.current
trigger: Click set A then B quickly
effect: Works because replace drops the older Task; the stage cannot tell which set it is switching to (the row shows no pending state for it)
fix: Switching{id,task}; open as the dialog's own presence

title: WordBar::Asking carries range+word instead of a request id; the answer is matched by normalized word via keyword_lookups, and it leaves by text edit or give-up in sync_emoji_words/answer_asked_word
trigger: Right-click a word, Suggest Emoji, keep typing / switch chat
effect: Asking is closed from two places (sync_emoji_words compare of the text, answer_asked_word); a bar for the same word asked by a highlight lookup would satisfy it
fix: Asking{request: RequestId} matched in the answer path

title: right_clicked_link is a one-shot slot cleared by a detached next-tick task that clears whatever is there
trigger: Right-press a link twice in one frame, or press where no menu opens
effect: The clearing task of the first press can drop the second press's link; slot has no owner stage
fix: hold the clearing Task with the slot (Option<(Point,LinkTarget,Task)>) or pass the link in the menu-open call

title: Folder picker answer is applied to whichever draft is open when it returns, not the draft that asked
trigger: Open Export chat for chat A, press Change (picker opens), cancel the box, open Export for chat B, then answer the first picker
effect: Chat B's draft gets the folder chosen for A's; the continuation is detached and carries no draft key
fix: hold the picker Task inside the draft (ExportPage::PickingFolder{task}) so closing the box drops it

title: Which export box shows is read from two owners: ExportBox::Options in the screen and session.settings.chat_export (+ ExportView) in the session; the dialog spec opens on either
trigger: Options draft open while a chat export or account export starts or ends elsewhere (other window, menu)
effect: Both can be set; build_chat_export_dialog prefers the draft, start_chat_export prefers the export; Cancel/on_close hide a running export's view by hand (set_chat_export_view(Hidden)) even when only the draft was closed
fix: one ExportStage enum owned by the session export: Options(draft) | Running{view} so a draft cannot coexist with a run

title: export_stop Option<Box<dyn Fn>> doubles as 'Stop and quit?' box open flag and exit continuation, kept in step with an alert dialog and the OS shutdown block reason by hand
trigger: Quit while exporting, let the export finish while the box is up, or close the window through another path
effect: Box and shutdown block reason stay up after the export ended until the user answers; a second Quit replaces the continuation and returns true; cleanup lives only in the alert's on_close
fix: QuitGate enum { Idle, Asking{exit} } cleared by the export ending as well as by the box

title: FirstRun::Welcome holds clip: Clip and outro: Option<Outro>; the Option is a 'way out started' flag that gates Clip::Writing -> Ready and the skip, settle and animating rules
trigger: Skip while the clip is still being written, or open timeout while Writing
effect: Combination (clip x outro) must be matched by hand in intro_written, awaits_intro, skip_intro, settle, animating; impossible mixes (Ready + outro past 1.0 with a playing player) are guarded by pause in settle
fix: flatten to Welcome stages: Writing | Playing{player} | Leaving{from,dark,player?} | Notice

title: start_intro spawns a detached task whose answer is matched by the shape of the stage (awaits_intro), not by an id held in Clip::Writing
trigger: Replay the onboarding from Settings twice before the first clip write finishes
effect: The first task to finish installs its player into whichever Welcome is current; the second is dropped silently; Writing does not own its Task
fix: Clip::Writing{task: Task<()>} replaced (and cancelled) by a new Replay

title: confirm_folder_new_chats takes the join dialog before the request goes out; a send error leaves only a note and the selection is lost
trigger: Tick chats in the shared-folder join box, press Join while the sender is closed
effect: Box closes, 'Failed to process new chats' note, user re-ticks everything; no stage for the join (fire and forget, the offer clears on a later update)
fix: NewChatsDialog stage Choosing | Joining{request} -> closes on answer, back to Choosing on error

title: Context menus are separate Option slots (folders.tab_menu, chat_list.menu, chat_list.archive_menu, message menu) made exclusive by hand at each opener
trigger: Right-click a folder tab while a chat row menu is open, or any new menu opener that forgets to clear one
effect: open_folder_tab_menu clears three other slots by hand; every opener must remember the others; esc layer 'context-menus' ORs them
fix: one ContextMenu enum { None, Message, Chat, Archive, FolderTab } so opening replaces the whole value

title: The chat-list view is two fields kept in step: ChatListUi::filter and FolderUi::tab
trigger: Select Unread while on a folder tab, delete the folder, or write either field directly
effect: selected_slot derives the highlighted tab from the pair ((Unread, Some(id)) shows Unread but the list still filters to the folder); each writer must keep both right (listed.rs:73 and notifications/mod.rs:460 do it separately)
fix: enum ChatListView { Main, Folder(i32), Unread{in_folder}, Archived }

title: Topic extras toast success when the request is sent; the answer is not matched
trigger: Mark topic mentions read, reorder pinned topics or unpin all messages when TDLib answers an error
effect: The 'marked as read' / 'reordered' / 'unpinning' note shows although the request failed
fix: carry the RequestId and settle the note from the answer

title: viewer.extra.share_at lives beside ForwardStage::Picking and is cleared by hand in three places
trigger: Share a video at a time from the viewer, then close the picker by Send, Escape in selection, or a chat switch (those paths set ForwardStage::None and never clear it), then open a picker over the same message with the selection's Forward button and use Copy link
effect: share_viewer_link_at_time still matches the stale (chat, message) and copies a link with the old timestamp
fix: carry the position in the stage (Picking { at_time: Option<i32>, .. }) so it dies with it

title: baseline: DestRow::saved
trigger: n/a
effect: A per-row fact (the chat is Saved Messages), not a stage; recorded as baseline debt
fix: derive from the chat kind at draw time or move to the allow list with its reason

title: ForwardLift is a process global marker kept in step with GPUI's active drag and cleared only when the button comes up
trigger: Lift a message drag, then cancel it without a mouse-up reaching end_forward_lift (focus loss, Escape), then start a file or text drag
effect: forward_lift_live = has_global && has_active_drag reads the next unrelated drag as a lifted message drag
fix: derive from the active drag's payload type (ForwardDrag) instead of a marker global

title: baseline: PasswordBox::sending
trigger: n/a
effect: PasswordBox is built each frame from the caller's stage; sending mirrors it as a bool
fix: pass the caller's stage (Showing) instead of a bool

title: baseline: PasswordBox::sending+error
trigger: n/a
effect: sending and error are both passed in, so a view can draw both at once
fix: one enum (Idle, Sending, Failed(error))
